name: Kawanishi (Nara, Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Kawanishi town emblem in white: a disc crossed by two diagonal strokes with a pointed stroke at the upper fly.
history: Municipal flag of Kawanishi, a town in Nara Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Kawanishi town emblem — a disc crossed by two diagonal strokes with a pointed stroke at the upper fly
